query:
SELECT fsd.id, fsd.protocolId, fsd.documentName, fsd.displayName, p.filename, p.trialId 
FROM fileSearchDocuments fsd 
JOIN protocols p ON fsd.protocolId = p.id 
LIMIT 10;
